verdict.rationale: Reducto Studio is referenced as a web UI where jobs are run and results persisted (docs-28, supp-1 'Studio-run jobs'), implying a browser-based playground exists, but no documentation describes an explicit drag-and-drop upload-then-preview-results workflow, and a community report on launch specifically flags the Studio link as broken (ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS), directly contradicting easy hands-on access. missing for 10: explicit product walkthrough/screenshots of drag-and-drop upload in Studio, confirmation the studio link issue was resolved, independent hands-on account of using Studio successfully.
